question: ¿Cuántos fármacos diferentes aparecen en ensayos de mieloma múltiple?

attempts.query:
WITH names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.parent_chembl_id AS pid, lower(m.pref_name) AS n FROM chembl.molecule_dictionary m WHERE m.pref_name IS NOT NULL AND m.parent_chembl_id IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT m.parent_chembl_id, lower(s.synonyms) FROM chembl.molecule_dictionary m JOIN chembl.molecule_synonyms s ON s.chembl_id = m.chembl_id WHERE m.parent_chembl_id IS NOT NULL
), trials AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT nct_id FROM aact.browse_conditions WHERE downcase_mesh_term = 'multiple myeloma'
), tn AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT lower(i.name) AS n FROM aact.interventions i JOIN trials t ON t.nct_id = i.nct_id
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT lower(o.name) FROM aact.intervention_other_names o JOIN trials t ON t.nct_id = o.nct_id
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT x.pid) FROM tn JOIN names x ON x.n = tn.n
